basis.exceptions: Only four original LF timer first-stage synchronizer D pins; no multicycle, asynchronous clock groups, user disable-timing or SysMem false paths.
basis.structure: 13040 declaration-only warned ports; all244 no-load drivers match unused ports; four unused original platform instances; constant/shared-net notices retained with functional same-netlist gate14.
basis.area: All SoC standard cells plus92 accelerator SRAM macros counted; excludes only128 reused TCM/shared macros. Thus newly added DMA/bridge/arbiter/FIFO/control cannot escape the conservative bound.
basis.function: Own ASIC14, CPU recovery76032 outputs, two contention cases and this exact repaired mapped gate14 pass; gate has no SDF. Own1200 remains pending.
basis.precision: DC exact6.666666ns; historical mapped SDC rounded6.66667ns preserved. New B PT must import separate exact SDC and report measured clocks.

limits: Extremely small positive setup/hold margins are synthesis-condition results, not physical margin.
PLL switching, active JTAG, startup/reset release, physical clocks and parasitics are outside this stable task mode.
Power activity/model impact and official600 precision remain independent unverified items.
The mapped repair is tied to the recorded seed and equivalent cell identities; historical inputs and failed attempts remain intact.
